checks.name: unauth-console-gate
checks.evidence: No-cookie /api/auth/me returned 401; visiting /cyclones with no session rendered data-testid login-screen with google-sign-in-button and zero top-header elements.

checks.name: dynamic-google-redirect
checks.evidence: Run against APP_URL https://cyclone-command-2.preview.emergentagent.com: clicking Continue with Google issued a request to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<origin>/ where redirect exactly equals window.location.origin + '/' captured at click time (no hardcoded fallback).

checks.name: authenticated-session-verification
checks.evidence: With seeded session_token cookie set, /api/auth/me returned 200 {name: 'Test Operator', email: 'test.user.1788885621@example.com'} and dashboard top-header rendered instead of login-screen.

checks.name: protected-routes-navigation
checks.evidence: Authenticated navigation to /cyclones, /satellite, /prediction, /history, /about, /settings each rendered the expected page-title; after clearing cookies, /prediction fell back to login-screen.

checks.name: user-profile-display
checks.evidence: Profile popover opened via header-profile-button showed 'Test Operator' and 'test.user.1788885621@example.com' plus a visible sign-out-button.

checks.name: test_tscheck_analyst_history_auth.py
checks.evidence: GET /analyst/history/tscheck-analyst-history-noauth with no cookie -> 401. GET /analyst/history/tscheck-analyst-history-authed with seeded session cookie -> 200 []; /auth/me with same cookie confirmed user_id test-user-1788885621 bound to the request.

checks.name: secure-sign-out
checks.evidence: Using dedicated fixture session tscheck_signout_token: pre-logout /api/auth/me=200, sign-out click returned UI to login-screen, post-logout /api/auth/me=401, and re-presenting the deleted cookie still returned 401.

checks.name: auth-callback-contract
checks.evidence: Navigating to /#session_id=tscheck-invalid-session-id triggered the callback exchange which failed against the upstream and fell back to login-screen with zero top-header elements (console never exposed).
